params.body:
The export on a campaign's /manage page carried all 22 columns of the finance export: tax certificate and invoice details, national registry numbers, addresses and Mollie ids. Those details are handled from the Tax certificates and Invoices tabs on /finance, where the certificate and invoice numbers are filled in and each tab has its own export with a campaign filter. A campaign export only needs the donations.

## Changes

- **Short columns on /manage**: `/api/finance-export?campaign=<slug>` now writes the columns of the campaign manager's export: date, name (with "(anonymous)" where it applies), email, type, amount, refunded, net amount, status, message. File name `afrodidact-<slug>-donations-<date>.csv`, as on the manager's page. Still gated by FINANCE_TOKEN.
- **One column list for both campaign pages**: `MANAGER_COLUMNS` is renamed `CAMPAIGN_COLUMNS`; the unit test that keeps national registry numbers, addresses, VAT, invoice and certificate numbers and Mollie ids out of it now covers both exports.
- The hint under the Donations card on /manage says where the tax certificate and invoice details are.

The Type column keeps the finance wording ("Recurring", "Recurring (1st)") on /manage; the manager's page says "Monthly".

## Verification

- `npm test`: 60 unit tests pass.
- A local build with Sanity and Mollie swapped for fixture stubs, driven by Playwright. The /manage export has the short header, no registry number, address, VAT, company or invoice and certificate number (also after numbers were typed in the tabs), and the same rows as the manager's export apart from the Type wording. The Invoices and Tax certificates exports still follow the campaign filter and carry their details. All suites pass: 25 finance checks, 20 campaign checks, 15 manager page checks.
params.title: Campaign export on /manage: donations only
